episode_title: 105. Cross Border, Cross Country: 1,000 Miles of RV Life as a British Expat in America

real_qa.q: How do UK custodians compare to American custodians for setting up accounts and moving client assets?
real_qa.r: The biggest difference is how badly UK custodians perform in comparison to Americans when setting up accounts. Moving money from one account to another to pull clients' assets together is a dream in the US, whereas the UK is just so far behind on that front.

real_qa.q: What are the key differences between taking a driving test in the UK versus New Hampshire?
real_qa.r: The US test is far more relaxed than the UK. In New Hampshire, after going up one road, doing a three-point turn, and leaving it in reverse—which would be an automatic failure in the UK—the examiner simply said 'you've been driving for years, haven't you?' and passed him after only three minutes in the car.
real_qa.requete: UK driving test vs US New Hampshire

real_qa.q: What is the Lincoln Undercroft at the Lincoln Memorial and when did it open?
real_qa.r: The Lincoln Undercroft opened in 2024 on the 250th anniversary and is located underneath the Lincoln Memorial. It shows the original plans for the memorial, including submissions for alternative designs such as a pyramid, and takes about 15 minutes to tour while exploring Lincoln's life.

real_qa.q: What were the average nightly and monthly costs for RV campgrounds in New Hampshire versus near Washington DC?
real_qa.r: In August in New Hampshire, with a longer-stay average campground including gas and electricity, it was about fifty dollars a night, totaling just over fifteen hundred dollars for the month. In September near DC, it was more like eighty dollars a night, resulting in approximately 2,400 dollars for the month.
real_qa.requete: RV campground costs New Hampshire DC monthly

real_qa.q: What was the RV failure that occurred at a Harvest Host vineyard near Philadelphia?
real_qa.r: While driving their one-ton RV into a shady area at a Harvest Host on the outskirts of Philadelphia on a hot day, the wheel started to sink into wet ground that had retained dew from the morning. They had to place stabilizer pads underneath to get traction to reverse out, and learned not to stay on grass anymore.
real_qa.requete: Harvest Host RV failure Philadelphia wet ground

real_qa.q: How many miles had James Beck and his family covered by the time of this episode?
real_qa.r: James and his family had covered just over a thousand miles traveling from New Hampshire through Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, and North Carolina, currently based in Greenville, South Carolina, heading toward Austin for the Grand Prix.
real_qa.requete: James Beck RV thousand miles traveled

guest.titre: UK Financial Planner transitioning to Cross-Border US-UK Advisor
guest.bio_context: James J.B. Beck is a British financial planner who has recently relocated to the United States and is morphing into a cross-border US-UK advisor. He is traveling across America in an RV with his wife Laura and their dog Ruby, covering over 1,000 miles while discovering different American states and their financial/regulatory environments compared to the UK custodian systems.

real_quote: The biggest thing for me is how badly the UK custodians are in comparison to the Americans, you know, setting up accounts.
key_stats: 1,000+ miles covered by James Beck and family in RV across northeastern and southeastern United States
August 2024: $50 per night campground costs in New Hampshire, totaling $1,500+ monthly
September 2024: $80 per night campground costs near Washington DC, totaling approximately $2,400 monthly
Lincoln Undercroft opened in 2024 on the 250th anniversary under the Lincoln Memorial
RV weight: one ton being towed
Maximum daily drive target: 300 miles per day, approximately six hours of driving plus setup and breakdown totaling eight hours
